To lay down his life for his friends

explanation: Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.

question: What did Jesus say He would do to him that cometh to Him?
choices: In no wise cast him out
explanation: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

question: What did Jesus say is the Father's will about all He has given Him?

That he should send them away
explanation: This is the Father's will... that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

question: What did Jesus say no man can come to Him except?
explanation: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him.

question: What did Jesus say became of the fathers who ate manna?
explanation: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.

question: What did Jesus say the bread He would give is?
choices: His flesh, given for the life of the world
explanation: The bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

question: Where did Jesus say these things?
explanation: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

question: What did many disciples say when they heard His teaching?
choices: This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
explanation: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

question: What did Jesus say profiteth nothing?
explanation: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing.

question: Whom did Jesus speak of when He said one of the twelve is a devil?
choices: Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon
explanation: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.

question: Why did Jesus walk in Galilee and not in Jewry?
choices: The Jews sought to kill him
explanation: Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.

question: Who told Jesus to depart and go into Judaea?
explanation: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea.

question: What is said of Jesus' brethren?
choices: They did not believe in him
explanation: For neither did his brethren believe in him.

question: What did Jesus say about His time?
choices: My time is not yet come
explanation: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.

question: What did the Jews ask at the feast?
explanation: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

question: What did some of the people say of Jesus?
explanation: Some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.

question: Where did Jesus teach in the midst of the feast?
explanation: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.

question: Whose doctrine did Jesus say His was?
explanation: My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

question: What did the people say when Jesus asked, Why go ye about to kill me?
explanation: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?

question: Who spoke up among the Pharisees on Jesus' behalf?
explanation: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,) Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him?

question: Why did His brethren say Jesus should go into Judaea?
choices: That his disciples might see his works
explanation: Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

question: What did His brethren say a man seeking to be known openly does not do?
explanation: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly.

question: Why did Jesus say the world hated Him?
choices: He claimed to be a king
He testified of it that its works are evil
explanation: Me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.

question: Why did no man speak openly of Jesus?
explanation: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.

question: What did the Jews marvel at in Jesus' teaching?
choices: How he knew letters, having never learned
explanation: The Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?

question: What did Jesus say about the man who will do God's will?
choices: He shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God
explanation: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God.

question: What did Jesus say of him that speaketh of himself?
explanation: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory.

question: What did Jesus say none of them did, though Moses gave the law?
explanation: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law?

question: What did Jesus point to when defending healing on the sabbath?
choices: They circumcise a man on the sabbath
An ox pulled from a pit
explanation: Ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man... are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

question: Why did some of Jerusalem doubt Jesus was the Christ?
choices: They knew whence he was; no man knows Christ's origin
He was born in a stable
explanation: We know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.

question: Why could no man lay hands on Jesus?
choices: His hour was not yet come
explanation: They sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.

question: Who sent officers to take Jesus?
choices: The Pharisees and the chief priests
explanation: The Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.

question: What did Jesus say to those who would seek Him?
choices: Ye shall find me at Jerusalem
Ye shall see me in Galilee
Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me
explanation: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.

question: Where did the Jews think Jesus would go?
choices: Unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, to teach them
explanation: Will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?

question: What did Jesus say the Jews were angry at Him for?
choices: Making a man every whit whole on the sabbath
explanation: Are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

question: When did Jesus go up to the feast?
choices: After his brethren were gone up
explanation: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.

question: Whom did Jesus say the world cannot hate?
explanation: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth.

question: When in the feast did Jesus go up into the temple and teach?
choices: About the midst of the feast
explanation: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.

question: Who did Jesus say is true, with no unrighteousness in him?
choices: He that seeketh the glory of him that sent him
explanation: He that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

question: From whom did Jesus say circumcision came, not from Moses?
explanation: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;).

question: What did some of Jerusalem wonder when the rulers said nothing to Him?
choices: Whether the rulers knew he was the very Christ
explanation: Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?

question: Who did Jesus say is true, whom they knew not?
explanation: I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.

question: What did many of the people who believed on Jesus ask?
choices: When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these?
Will he free us from Rome?
explanation: When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?

question: What did Jesus say He would do after a little while?
choices: Go unto him that sent him
explanation: Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.

question: On which day of the feast did Jesus stand and cry?
choices: The last day, that great day
explanation: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried.

question: Why was the Holy Ghost not yet given?
explanation: The Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.

question: What did some say, doubting that Jesus was the Christ?
choices: Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
Is he not the carpenter's son?
explanation: But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?

question: From which town did the scripture say Christ cometh?
explanation: Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was.

question: What did Nicodemus say the law must do before judging a man?
choices: Hear him, and know what he doeth
explanation: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?

question: What did the Pharisees say of the people who knew not the law?
explanation: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.
